Event notice for an AU communication and ICT committee session; Djibouti appears only as 2nd Vice-Chair of the Bureau, nothing on an access to information law.

facts.fact: The Council of Ministers, chaired by the head of state, examined and approved the draft law on the Digital Code, whose Book VII provides a general right of access to administrative documents and public information with rules on how it is exercised; the report is undated, published 2023-06-01 and the session is inferred to be early June 2023.
